verdict.rationale: Wave's first-party docs say Pro Plan users can connect bank accounts so transactions automatically import, merge, and categorize into bookkeeping. The story asks for more than that, so this is partial: the docs say nothing about credit-card accounts or a daily import schedule, the feature is paywalled to Pro, and nothing independent or hands-on confirms it. missing for 10: explicit support for connecting credit-card accounts, a documented daily/recurring import cadence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: Connect your bank accounts in seconds with the Pro Plan. Transactions will appear in your bookkeeping automatically
With the Pro Plan, automatically import, merge, and categorize your bank transactions.
Auto-import bank transactions... Auto-merge and categorize bank transactions
